lines.t: Clean hair, soft seats, bibles folded tight; we know the rules, we shine our light.
He tells me “My plumb line stands in midst; the trumpet sounds the hour,
Come out - sell house, sell steeple, sell all that props your power.
Give it to the poor; lay yourself upon My stone; follow Me.”
hey? what’s the deal? I kept the rules; I give when asked, I sing your songs.
He tells me “You will be tried; you will be sifted; give me the things you’ve kept too long.”
I don’t sleep around, I don’t steal - my name’s clean, my life is fair.
telling me , I want the things you just won’t give me; come out of comfort’s snare.”
He says “Come out, come out - the harvest presses hard; the line is drawn; My door will close.”
I hear the call; the price is clear. I taste the cost; can I let go?
hey? what’s the deal? I kept the rules; I gave when asked, I sung your songs.
Telling me “You are tried; you are sifted; give me all that you are . don't wait too long.”
but Can I take that leap?
